anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Leave nothing till morning; burn the remainder.
You shall not break a bone.
No bone broken; none left till morning.
Not a bone of him shall be broken.

pass_a_gloss: You shall not leave from it until morning, and a bone you shall not crush from it; and the things left from it until morning you shall burn down in fire.
pass_b_english: You shall not leave any of it until morning, and you shall not break a bone of it; and what is left of it until morning you shall burn with fire (Exodus 12:10) (Exodus 12:46) (Numbers 9:12) (John 19:36).
source_text: [Οὐκ ἀπολείψετε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἕως πρωΐ, καὶ ὀστοῦν οὐ συντρίψετε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ· τὰ δὲ καταλειπόμενα ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἕως πρωῒ ἐν πυρὶ κατακαύσετε.]
